description: This source file defines the class PipelineElementUnresolved, which represents a specific, immutable pipeline element signifying a failed resolution within a larger pipeline processing framework. It implements the PipelineElement interface and provides behaviors such as returning its type, handling resolution and unresolution events, accepting visitors, and iteration.

classes.name: PipelineElementUnresolved
classes.description: A singleton class representing an unresolved pipeline element, indicating failed resolution in a processing pipeline.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the pipeline element, which is UNRESOLVED.

methods.name: onResolved
methods.description: Handles the event of resolution; returns itself since unresolved elements do not change state.

methods.name: onUnresolved
methods.description: Handles the unresolved event by returning the next pipeline element provided by the supplier.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing PipelineElementVisitor, invoking its `unresolved` method.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an empty iterator, indicating no contained elements.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the simple class name as the string representation.
